title: Lecture 9 — types and parametric polymorphism
summary: Read generic signatures and distinguish when type errors are detected across programming languages.
body:
Authored study companion based on the published lecture slides, checked 17 November. Work through the topic below, then attempt its self-check before opening the solution.

Distinguish static checking from annotations, infer generic function signatures, and connect lambdas with functional programming.

Read the linked original slides for Pyking syntax and language comparisons.
